package.name: cyton_hardware
package.description: ros2_control SystemInterface plugin (cyton_hardware/CytonSystemHardware) bridging the Cyton Gamma 1500's Dynamixel servos to ros2_control/MoveIt, by directly compiling this repo's own src/dynamixel_motor.cpp and src/robot_calibration.cpp (not a reimplementation -- see this package's CMakeLists.txt). Requires external/DynamixelSDK to be populated at the top-level repo root (run 'git submodule update --init --recursive').
